paper.title: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
paper.summary: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extends residual connections to multiple streams and stabilizes residual propagation by constraining stream-mixing residual matrices to the Birkhoff polytope, the set of doubly stochastic matrices. In this work, we investigate how to effectively mix residual streams within the Birkhoff polytope. paper.ai_summary: Constraining residual stream mixing within the Birkhoff polytope via geometric contraction improves stability and scalability of hyper-connections in large-scale dense and mixture-of-experts model pretraining.

paper.title: Non-penetrating World Models
paper.summary: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles. Our evaluation reveals that none of the open-source models can reliably prevent such failures. Surprisingly, however, these models already encode the information needed to predict such violations. paper.ai_summary: A benchmark and lightweight framework leverage hidden states from frozen diffusion transformers to detect and prevent object penetration in interactive video world models, reducing physical violations and generalizing zero-shot.

paper.title: Learning Video Foresight Reasoning from Unlabeled Videos via On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.summary: Video foresight reasoning requires vision-language models to anticipate future events or next actions from currently observed videos. Existing methods fit future captions, rationales, or full visual states, but face two limitations. First, they rely on annotations or external large models for supervision, limiting scalability. We address this with an on-policy self-distillation framework that turns past-future video pairs into a natural self-supervised signal without extra annotations or LLM sup…
paper.ai_summary: Future-OPSD trains vision-language models via on-policy self-distillation and a contrastive privilege advantage derived from a foresight score, improving video foresight prediction and planning without extra annotations or LLM supervision.

paper.title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report
paper.summary: We introduce Clover-35B-A3B-Preview (Clover), a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with 35 billion total parameters and 3 billion activated parameters, supporting thinking-mode generation. paper.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
paper.summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands.
